name: Modern Furniture Manufacturing Company
old_description: We’ve been supplying commercial & wholesale custom millwork for over 20 years –
about:
Modern Furniture Manufacturing Company operates from Lindenhurst, New York, where it has been supplying commercial and wholesale custom millwork for over two decades. The company manages every phase of a project in-house, employing its own installers, delivery fleet, estimators, and designers.

The shop fabricates a wide range of millwork products including cabinetry, casework, countertops, workstations, built-ins, and specialty items such as nurse stations, teller counters, and exam room components. Materials processed span wood, veneer, solid surface, stone, plastic laminate, melamine, mica, and thermofoil, with brand-name laminates from Formica, Wilsonart, and Nevamar and solid surfaces from Corian, LG Hausys, and Silestone.

Its client base covers nearly every segment of commercial construction: retail stores, hospitals and medical facilities, educational institutions, financial centers, hotels, and religious centers. The company also works with contractors and property owners on custom projects that require precise color, material, and quality matching.

Leadership emphasizes superior quality, deadline readiness, exemplary customer service, and competitive pricing as the factors that distinguish the firm. The team includes veterans of operations, production, finance, and purchasing who oversee fabrication, drafting, and installation to ensure projects ship on time or earlier.
